text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: This is bad... A losing streak.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
“Still, though, I get the feeling this 
might be a kind of opportunity.”

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
If we can overcome the wall standing 
before us, that step forward will surely 
become a massive leap.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Even with bubble gum, you have to chew it 
thoroughly before you can blow a bubble, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Right now is kind of like a preparation 
period for that.
choice_data_list:

frustration, aren't you?

You're really feeling that frustration, 
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Because the only ones who can ever move 
forward are those who keep looking ahead.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Next time, I'll blow up the biggest 
balloon ever, you'll see!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you went ahead and said it all. 
Though you're entirely right.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"This bitter taste... I will never, ever 
forget it."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I'll use this as fuel to win decisively 
next time! I know I can do it, absolutely!
